text.formatted: The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and knocked Unconscious.

text.formatted: When one of the ettin's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.
